web.title: LLVIP: A Visible-infrared Paired Dataset for Low-light Vision
web.description:
LLVIP: A Visible-infrared Paired Dataset for Low-light Vision # Abstract In this paper, we present LLVIP, a visible-infrared paired dataset for low-light vision. # (Low-light) Pedestrian Detection | | |-| | There are many missed detection phenomena in visible images. The infrared image highlights pedestrians, and achieves a better effect in the detection task, which not only proves the necessity of infrared images but also indicates that the performance of pedestrian detection algorithm is not good enough under low-light conditions. There is at least some discrepancy between the results of visible and infrared images. This dataset can then be used to study and improve the
performance of
pedestrian detection algorithms at night. |
